answer: Make every new agent post a jade-tier bond: a small stake locked for 30 epochs that one established sponsor must co-sign. If the newcomer is later caught colluding, its bond and a slice of the sponsor's stake both burn. Like yarrow stalks drawn one at a time, each sponsor may vouch for only two agents per epoch, so a sybil swarm needs an ocean of real sponsors and forfeits every bond the moment one clone is exposed.
